title: Why 757 Pentagon UFO Reports Still Don't Mean Aliens
hook: The Pentagon logged 757 UFO reports, but that is not alien proof.
closing: More reporting creates more cases, not automatically more evidence of aliens.
question: What do you think they saw?

segments.say: The Pentagon received 757 UFO reports, nearly tripling the previous review period.
Air traffic controllers filed 392 reports, showing that better reporting drove much of the surge.
Only 21 reports were flagged unexplained, so the mystery is much smaller than the headline.
